note: [agent] good - nothing is missing from shw 37016 (132.9 MeV, 11 seg). nu vertex right: the 36 cm pdg-13 segment 4000 leaves it and the shower is on the other side, detached, closest member 26.4 cm out. THE VERDICT RESTS ON THE NON-MEMBERS, not on the shape: every non-member within 40 cm lies at 103-173 deg from the axis, i.e. behind the start, and the six of them are 0.2-7.1 MeV vertex fragments on the muon side. There is nothing in the event to add. The shape number is NOT usable here and I am not resting on it: the 11 members are a chain strung along the axis from t = -38 to +24 cm, seven of them 2- or 3-point stubs, so the transverse RMS (8.2 cm, w/l 0.26) measures the scatter of stubs, not a shower width - restricted to the four members with >= 5 fitted points it is 3.4 cm, w/l 0.13. Note the shower table's own length (27.7 cm) and the extent over all member points (62.1 cm) are different definitions and disagree by 2x for the same reason. What I did NOT test: whether the far stubs out to 88 cm from the vertex genuinely belong to this shower. Only one photon in the event, so no pi0 pair; kine_pio_* pairs it with a 5.7 MeV stub for 35.9 MeV and that is a BDT feature, not a pairing.
